suppress.notes: CVE-2026-116804 / GHSA-cg2g-xh64-v4q7 requires SAFE_FOR_TEMPLATES together with a DOM-returning mode and input containing an attached shadow root. The reviewed Swagger UI 5.32.15 bundle embeds DOMPurify 3.4.13 in a scoped instance. Its Markdown renderer passes an HTML string to sanitize() with ADD_ATTR, FORBID_TAGS, ALLOW_DATA_ATTR and FORBID_ATTR only; it does not enable SAFE_FOR_TEMPLATES, RETURN_DOM, RETURN_DOM_FRAGMENT or IN_PLACE. The sanitized string is rendered as HTML, not evaluated by a template engine. This is non-applicability in this integration, not a patched DOMPurify library or accepted residual risk. The hash restricts this rule to the exact reviewed bundle and embedded version. Reassess when the bundle, sanitizer configuration, input type or rendering integration changes. Verified on 2026-10-29. Reference: https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify/security/advisories/GHSA-cg2g-xh64-v4q7

CVE-2026-116803 / GHSA-mrv2-3pqr-j5jr requires IN_PLACE sanitization and a hook that detaches a parent or sibling, leaving its event handlers unsanitized. The reviewed Swagger UI 5.32.15 bundle embeds DOMPurify 3.4.13 in a scoped instance. Its Markdown renderer sanitizes an HTML string without IN_PLACE. Its beforeSanitizeElements hook only sets rel="noopener noreferrer" on links; it does not detach DOM nodes. Both required conditions are absent. This is non-applicability in this integration, not a patched DOMPurify library or accepted residual risk. The hash restricts this rule to the exact reviewed bundle. Reassess when the bundle, sanitizer options, input type or hooks change. Verified on 2026-10-29. Reference: https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify/security/advisories/GHSA-mrv2-3pqr-j5jr

CVE-2026-104828 affects HTMLWriterFilter when serializing textarea/title text. The reviewed CMS uses Neko through wjdaisydiff in DocTools.getHtmlDiff(). NekoHtmlParser creates a SAXParser and forwards events to the DaisyDiff content handler; the result is serialized through HtmlSaxDiffOutput and SAX/XSL transformers. Inspection of the resolved dependencies and local DaisyDiff JAR confirms that this path does not instantiate or configure HTMLWriterFilter. This is non-applicability in the reviewed integration, not a patched Neko library or accepted residual risk. Reassess when Neko/DaisyDiff versions, HTML output handling or custom integrations change, especially if HTMLWriterFilter is introduced. Verified on 2026-10-29. Reference: https://github.com/HtmlUnit/htmlunit-neko/security/advisories/GHSA-39xg-prhf-8785
